notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {G} or {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.
